question: The NHL was born 109 years ago today, on Nov. 26, 1917, at a Montreal hotel. What was the owners' main reason for starting a brand-new league?
question_short: The NHL was founded 109 years ago today. Why did owners start a whole new league?
answer: B: To freeze out one owner
answer_detail: The old NHA's rules wouldn't let owners expel Toronto's feuding boss Eddie Livingstone, so they simply started a new league without him. Season one went badly too: the Wanderers' rink burned and only three teams finished.
answer_short: Rivals couldn't expel Toronto owner Eddie Livingstone, so they formed a new league without him.
